description: nginx config security audit — Parse an nginx config and flag security problems: alias off-by-slash path traversal, weak TLS protocols and ciphers, autoindex, proxy_pass built from request data (SSRF), $uri CRLF redirects, PHP locations without try_files, root /, permissive CORS, missing HSTS / X-Frame-Options / nosniff per server, plain HTTP without redirect, server_tokens, add_header inheritance traps. Pass text= (config) or url= (raw file). Returns PASS/REVIEW/FAIL, score, grade, findings with line numbers and fixes, and a per-server summary. Offline. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description: server { listen 80; location /static { alias /var/www/static/; autoindex on; } }

name: security_nginx_check
